verdict.rationale: Devin's own guidance says to carve out independent tasks and run them simultaneously, which is a form of acting on many items in parallel. It also positions itself for codebase-wide migrations and refactors. There is no documented first-class bulk or batch feature (e.g., applying one operation across many tickets, repos, or sessions in a single action); the API is only a building block for constructing one. Missing for 10: a documented batch/bulk operation feature, details on how parallel sessions are launched at scale, limits on concurrency, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Carve out independent tasks and run them simultaneously.
